visual_action: A montage of clips showing Melania Trump at the White House receiving the official Christmas tree. She waves as she walks out of the building. A horse-drawn carriage carrying a large Christmas tree arrives, driven by men in tuxedos and top hats. There are close-up shots of the horses' hooves, their harnesses, the branches of the tree, and sheet music for Christmas carols. A military band is playing. Melania Trump stands by the carriage, smiles, and pets one of the horses.
